changes_made.explanation: Added semantic parsing as an explicit NLG task mentioned in the paper. Removed duplicate/overlapping model names. Normalized model names to consistent format with version numbers. Added more specific output description.
Simplified 'classification accuracy' to 'Accuracy' as they refer to the same metric. The paper uses accuracy as the main evaluation metric.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are only used as the systems being evaluated.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations - all evaluations are automated using accuracy metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' understanding of converse relations through structured data-to-text and text-to-structured data tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and removal of duplicates. The paper uses multiple LLM families (OpenAI GPT series, Anthropic Claude, Google Flan-T5) evaluated on their ConvRe benchmark dataset.
